status: Development procedure basis, NOT an approved operator or maintenance manual

procedures.title: Before first service / after material change
procedures.trigger: Initial operation, route change, new consist or altered hardware/process/software/repair.
development_sequence: Match actual serial/revision/consist/route to signed accepted configuration and manuals; close applicable design/manufacturing/site/authority/test gates for this use.
Review S2 change-impact cases and documented regression decision; no automatic transfer of prototype or trailer evidence.

Appoint qualified roles, inspect protected route/stations and verify emergency access/equipment/communications. Accepted controls/limits/defect criteria and shift checks must be present before authorization.
procedures.stop_or_hold: Missing governing approval, actual control procedure, critical limit, qualified staffing or accepted test evidence means no operation.

procedures.title: Preopening / after interruption inspection
procedures.trigger: Proposed preopening each operating day, and after weather/impact/repair/extended interruption as accepted by the responsible engineer.
development_sequence: Inspect actual route, drainage, formation/fasteners/joints, crossings/turnouts/protection, clearance and stations against accepted survey/track limits; record defects and protect work limits.

Inspect every vehicle wheel/axlebox/suspension/retention, couplings and guards, D1 hub/carrier/cam/chamber/hoses, body/doors/platform/stairs and accessible equipment using safe visible access and the accepted inspection plan.

Verify fluid/fuel/exhaust/cooling and electrical/HVAC/emergency/communication condition; complete protected charging and every-vehicle brake application/release/readiness checks using approved methods. Record actual observations, not a pressure-only pass.
procedures.stop_or_hold: Any structural/running-gear/brake/track/boarding uncertainty or missing accepted inspection limit is no-dispatch until qualified disposition.

procedures.title: Secured boarding and departure authorization
procedures.trigger: Each departure and each boarding event at origin orNorthPole.
development_sequence: Use only the accepted stopped boarding interface and actual holding state; protect people from moving vehicles, couplings, pinch zones and adjacent track.

Board within accepted occupancy/seat/wheelchair/companion arrangement. Trained assistance follows the accepted accessible equipment/securement/evacuation plan; no improvised carrying or mobility-device substitution.
Confirm passenger count, designated seated positions and clearance; positively stow/secure actual doors/gates/stairs/lift/bridge and verify physical status, not an assumed indicator alone.

Boarding lead gives the one defined clear signal; dispatch confirms protected route; driver confirms every-vehicle brake reserve/release/continuity and accepted run state. No movement on a conflicting or missing confirmation.
procedures.stop_or_hold: Open/unsecured equipment, unclear status/communication, inadequate holding or inaccessible accepted boarding solution means hold boarding/departure.

procedures.title: Normal running, stopping and station arrival
procedures.trigger: Only after actual passenger operation is accepted for the specific route/direction/consist.
development_sequence: Use accepted speed/direction/sight-distance and route occupancy rules; this document supplies no mph or minimum headway.

Monitor actual brake/power readiness, wheel/vehicle condition and communications. A staff stop request must have a defined understood response; lost/ambiguous route permission is not permission to continue.

Arrive using the validated braking/control procedure, establish accepted stopped holding and route protection, then permit boarding equipment/doors to be used. A drivetrain or hydrostatic resistance is not credited as parking.
procedures.stop_or_hold: No routine pushing/reversing/run-around/towing or second-train service from a locomotive reverser or from this normal-operation outline.

procedures.title: Fault stop, report and dispatch lockout
procedures.trigger: Readiness alarm/disagreement, leakage, unexpected brake drag, response loss, strike/derailment indication or credible unsafe condition.
development_sequence: Invoke the actual approved stop response and protect route/people; notify dispatch/boarding/maintenance through the defined communication chain.
Record time/location, exact vehicle/component, alarms/pressures/mechanical behavior, passengers and relevant environment without entering an unsafe zone.
Place affected train/track out of service pending qualified diagnosis. Preserve evidence and avoid repetitive resets or fault clearing that hides the cause.
procedures.stop_or_hold: No bridged interlock, repeated-reset dispatch, pressure-only assurance, release of an isolated spring brake, or unapproved passenger movement on remaining brakes.

procedures.title: Parking, end of shift and storage
procedures.trigger: End of service, unattended storage or maintenance handover.
development_sequence: Use accepted storage track, protected route and actual stopped parking/independent restraint sequence; verify holding physically using the approved method.
Record consist, brake/energy status and outstanding defects. Secure controls/access, maintain required emergency/fire protection and perform actual OEM/engineer shutdown and weather protection.

Do not disconnect power, vent reservoirs or uncouple until the accepted sequence proves restraint and people are clear; spring air loss can change brake forces and is not a universal shutdown instruction.
procedures.stop_or_hold: No assumed0%survey or hydrostatic holding; no unattended vehicle with unproved parking, caged brake or unknown restraint state.

procedures.title: Protected maintenance and hazardous-energy control
procedures.trigger: Service, access under/within train, component removal or adjustment.
development_sequence: Qualified lead identifies the exact task and all possible energy/reaccumulation sources; accepted vehicle restraint, track protection and lifting/support points precede work.
Use the accepted equipment-specific isolation/blocking/verification procedure and controlled lock transfer. Cab buttons, an E-stop or a software flag are not physical isolation.

Control air, electrical/charger/shore, engine fuel/start, drive pressure/inertia, loaded springs and gravity separately. Gauge zero or an empty air reservoir does not remove stored spring or suspended-body energy.
Maintain verification and work boundaries through the task; use only accepted joint/material/process/OEM service documents. Spring-brake chamber internals are not farm fabrication/service work.
procedures.stop_or_hold: No generic vent-all-air, spring-chamber opening/caging, lifting or underbody access procedure is provided. Missing exact isolation/restraint/support evidence means stop work.

procedures.title: Emergency protection, assistance and evacuation
procedures.trigger: Fire/smoke, medical issue, loss of movement/power, blocked route/exit or other emergency.
development_sequence: Use the accepted emergency stop/route protection and incident communications; summon emergency services when needed and identify actual accessible route/location for responders.

Incident lead assesses immediate danger and whether remaining aboard or controlled evacuation offers lower risk; do not automatically keep people aboard in fire/smoke or evacuate into moving-track/terrain hazards.

For controlled assisted unloading or bridge/lift use, verify and maintain the accepted vehicle holding/independent restraint arrangement as applicable; account for floor/suspension movement while passengers leave. The accepted emergency plan must separately prioritize immediate escape from fire/smoke without a blanket restraint-verification delay.

Trained staff account for passengers, mobility needs and companions; use only qualified deployed exits/equipment and the accepted off-station rescue plan. Maintain lighting, guarded paths and accessible assistance without improvised carrying/transfer.
Keep other movements/work isolated; preserve route/rescue access. Reunification/accounting and medical handover follow the actual accepted site plan.
procedures.stop_or_hold: Do not rely solely on moving back to a station. No staff lifting/carrying, improvised bridge, unqualified lift or routine pushing authority is created here.
existing_records_to_reuse: 3E mockup/observation and E13/E14 installed exercise records
3S.2 E12/13/14 and actual accepted emergency plan

procedures.title: Specialist rescue, towing or derailment recovery
procedures.trigger: A disabled or displaced vehicle cannot be restored by normal accepted operation.
development_sequence: Protect all route/work zones and independently restrain actual vehicles before any brake/coupling/energy change. Assess passenger evacuation separately from recovery.

Qualified responsible professionals approve the exact rescue consist, direction, brake command/continuity, coupling/compression, traction/visibility, damaged wheel/track and lifting/rerailing plan before movement.

Any OEM-specific mechanical spring release is performed only by qualified personnel under that independently restrained procedure; record each disabled/caged brake and its effect. No operational holding credit remains for a mechanically disabled spring.
After recovery, quarantine damage/changed configuration until inspections, repairs and documented regression/return-to-service release are complete.
procedures.stop_or_hold: No improvised farm-tractor tow, chain substitution, jacking/rerailing point, caging instruction or passenger movement with disabled brakes is authorized.

procedures.title: Return to service after repair, release/caging or change
procedures.trigger: After any defect, maintenance isolation, repair, mechanical brake release, recoupling or configuration change.
development_sequence: Document exact repair/configuration and accountable inspection; verify every removed part/guard/retainer/fastener, coupling/trainline and disabled brake is restored to the accepted build.

Qualified energy-control lead verifies work area/people/tools and actual equipment integrity; remove locks/restraints only by the accepted responsible handover procedure. Energization for guarded tests is not passenger dispatch.

Complete documented S2 impact assessment and required approved regression tests; every vehicle must show actual application/release/readiness after reconnection or brake work. Resolve anomalies and retain raw evidence.

Operating manager accepts only the specifically released configuration and qualified staff/route. Re-enter preopening/boarding checks; never treat an indicator reset or publication as return-to-service approval.
procedures.stop_or_hold: Unrestored caging/isolated brake, unknown defect cause, unapproved deviation, missing inspection or failed/absent required regression keeps the train out of service.

scope_rule: Steps specify functions/evidence to develop, not physical cab/valve/caging actions. Actual controls, approved numerical limits, safe methods, applicability and responsible signoff are prerequisites to use.
